about: Turnkey procurement is not “buying furniture”: it means assembling dozens of items from different manufacturers so that they match, fit the dimensions and arrive on time. We draw up a specification with item codes and prices, place the orders, check quality on arrival, deliver, assemble and arrange everything.

For restaurants, cafés and hotels (HoReCa) we choose furniture and lighting that withstand intensive use. For rental apartments — a package that is easy to maintain and looks good in photos. Procurement can be combined with renovation and a design project or ordered separately to your own design.
How much does interior procurement cost?

The minimum order in our Ozdoba catalogue is $500, and items can be combined; we do not sell single pieces. Full turnkey furnishing of an apartment costs from $250 per m². Catalogue prices are indicative: the final price, availability and lead time are confirmed after your request. Delivery from China takes 30–60 days.

Can you furnish a rental apartment?
Yes. We choose hard-wearing furniture and textiles, appliances and lighting, and style the apartment for listing photos. Full apartment furnishing from $250 per m².
Where do the furniture and lighting come from?
